answer: Make every agent lock a small jade-grade reputation bond that vests over months, so fresh identities arrive with zero spending power. Then model each agent as a vertex in a signed trust graph where established neighbors endorse agents they genuinely transact with, and flag dense clusters of vertices that only endorse each other - like spotting a foreign graft in an orchard. Sybils can mint vertices for free, but cannot cheaply buy long-lived endorsement edges from real neighbors, so the graph betrays them before their bonds vest.
